Use the real text: line 1 ends 'His chest felt tight,' and line 2 ends 'like the air in the room was thinning out. The …'. Remove the third line. Shift the row title down 1px (y 207 instead of 206).

fixes.problem: The form text is about 1px off vertically and wider than the real text. The title is at y28 in the real screen but y27 in the mock. Placeholders start at x41 instead of 40. The warning text is bolder. The upload box border is thicker.
fixes.fix: Shift the title and all labels down 1px. Set the placeholder padding-left so the text starts at x40, font-size 15px, weight 400. Set the warning text to weight 600 with a slightly narrower letter-spacing (-0.1px). Make the dashed border 1px #7c4fe0. Ensure the 'Character Bio' label sits at y692.

summary: All data-el boxes, taps and contracts pass, so the score is limited by pixel-level differences, mostly text rendering. The biggest wins this round are s20's snippet wrapping (two lines with an ellipsis) and the blurry avatars, then the nav swirl logo, the s05 tab underline and the 1px text offsets on s24.
